title: Super professional football tour for the whole family
text: Avi, make the tour fun and interactive, suitable for all ages. He was attentive, patient, professional, and knowledgeable about the world of football. Gave amazing tips for the rest of the trip and was very helpful and available. Recommended!!
author: 715shania

title: A cool and educational tour of the history of the Barcelona football team
text:
I had an experiential tour with Gabi on the history of the Barcelona football team.
The tour was part of a Bar Mitzvah trip with my son to Superclásico.
The tour was cool, educational, and also put in a special atmosphere on game day.
About the cannon, patient, pleasant, and conveys knowledge in an interesting way suitable for both children and adults.
Both the coordination with him and the payment were good and suitable.

I would like to return for more tours in the city in the future.

Thank you very much for everything!
author: 573sagil

title: Worthwhile tour in Barcelona
text:
It was an interesting and enjoyable tour.
Gabriel knows how to tell the story and make you feel like you are part of the neighborhood and the club.
Highly recommended for football fans, for those who are not football fans, friends and families with children.
In short, recommended for everyone.
Great experience

text:
Gabriel was absolutely fantastic, and our entire family loved our time with him. He coordinated two full days for us, including transportation, meals, and tickets to all of the sites, which made everything incredibly easy and enjoyable.

The highlight was his FC Barcelona Walking Tour. Gabriel put together a full day that really brought the history of FC Barcelona to life. His knowledge of Barça, football, and other clubs is incredible, and his passion for the sport made the experience even more engaging. He also knows Barcelona extremely well and took us to places we never would have discover
